Codebook of a data frame

Source: R/describe.R
bdhs_describe.Rd

Summarises every column of a data frame: its variable label, type, number of valid and missing values and its declared value labels. Works on any data frame, including data from bdhs_read() and bdhs_simulate().

Usage

bdhs_describe(data)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

Value

A tibble with one row per column: variable, label, type, n_valid, n_missing, n_value_labels and value_labels (compact "value=label; ..." string for labelled columns, "level; ..." for factors). The bdhs_survey_id and bdhs_recode attributes of data are kept.

Details

Only metadata is reported. No data values are shown, apart from the declared label sets (value labels of labelled columns and factor levels), so the result is safe to share even for licensed microdata.

See also

bdhs_variable() for a variable across rounds in the bundled codebook.

Examples

ir <- bdhs_simulate(2022, "IR", n_clusters = 4, households = 5)
bdhs_describe(ir)
#> # A tibble: 116 × 7
#>    variable label            type  n_valid n_missing n_value_labels value_labels
